name: codex-windows-prevention
runtime: Python standard library, Python 3.10 or newer
powershell_parser: Fixed Windows PowerShell 5.1 by default; an explicit absolute executable selects PowerShell 7
limitations: Command analysis does not prove command behavior or test coverage.
Unknown command and tool payload shapes are reported as unsupported.
The hook does not approve a command or prove hook trust.
PowerShell syntax parsing does not execute a candidate script or prove its prerequisites.
Visible shell bodies are inspected to a bounded depth. Further nested shells require reviewed steps or a direct reviewed script.
re_audit: Review after Codex hook schema, PowerShell, ripgrep, Python launcher, or process routing changes.
